novelty.justification: The core novelty route is a task-specific mechanistic relationship: the claim predicts that a capability "switches on" when "task-relevant linear features becomes disentangled (separable, monosemantic) in the residual stream," rather than merely observing a loss or behavioral threshold. Searches using "emergent abilities feature geometry language model checkpoints," "representation geometry phase transitions Pythia OLMo," and "feature disentanglement capability emergence sparse autoencoder" identified the closest work as Tracing the Representation Geometry of Language Models from Pretraining to Post-training (2025), which already tracks effective rank and geometric phases across Pythia and OLMo training and connects a geometric transition to downstream improvement; related precedents also include Olsson et al. (2022) and Nanda et al. (2023) on capability-associated circuit formation during training. Moving from those studies to task-specific separability and monosemanticity as predictors of behavioral emergence, with selective feature ablation as the proposed mechanistic interpretation, is a substantive natural extension and multi-step operationalization—not merely a renamed method—but it does not introduce an entirely new geometric or intervention paradigm.
